payload.rationale: This sprint retro directly echoes the Sprint 4 retro (2026-03-22) already in the graph: same async decision widget, same 23-point velocity claim, same Zephyr-as-key-unlock attribution. I expanded every position and narrative the document could bear on — the Zephyr integration position and webhook architecture behind it, the thesis-proven position and the core decision-capture narrative it rests on, the velocity observation and metric-anchor style observation that match the document's quantified claims, and the broader anti-Slack positioning and decisions-evaporate narratives that give the widget its strategic context. I also included the next-sprint context-preservation position (the stated follow-on), pricing positions (updated at the prior retro), and target-market position for full product-vision context. I did not expand the Sample_Sprint4Retro source node itself since its content is already represented through the positions and observations that cite it.
